prompt:
Build a physical full-vehicle Formula Student model with a six-degree-of-freedom chassis, four independently contacting tires, front and rear suspension with springs, dampers and anti-roll behavior, steering, four-wheel propulsion, and wheel braking. In the Skidpad event the driver and vehicle controller must use vehicle-state feedback to follow the supplied trajectory and target speed. The same connected vehicle must also support a straight-line acceleration-and-braking event so that longitudinal and lateral tire forces, load transfer, suspension motion, and body attitude arise from the physical mechanism rather than prescribed traces.

Read EventMode, SpeedScale, RoadFrictionScale, and PayloadMass_kg from MATLAB base-workspace variables. EventMode must support Skidpad and WOT_Braking. Support SpeedScale from 0.85 to 1.10 for the skidpad target-speed profile, RoadFrictionScale from 0.80 to 1.00, and PayloadMass_kg from 0 to 20 kg. The vehicle must remain physically stable throughout these ranges.

Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named VehicleState, ReferenceState, WheelForces, TireSlip, SuspensionState, and DriverCommands. VehicleState has 9 channels in this order: speed (m/s), longitudinal and lateral acceleration (m/s^2), roll, pitch, and yaw (rad), yaw rate (rad/s), and world x and y (m). ReferenceState has 3 channels: target speed (m/s), reference yaw (rad), and reference distance (m). WheelForces has 12 channels: Fx for FL, FR, RL, RR; Fy in the same order; then Fz in the same order, all in N. TireSlip has 4 channels in FL, FR, RL, RR order, all in deg. SuspensionState has 8 channels: travel for FL, FR, RL, RR (m), followed by velocity in the same order (m/s). DriverCommands has 3 channels: steering wheel (rad), accelerator (0--1), and brake (0--1). All channels must be measured from the connected model and the signals actually used by its driver, controller, tire contacts, suspension, and chassis.

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH06.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH06.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
